C-NEG.note: Improves binding retention but induces authority_inversion=327 and recall collapse in ARM-03 -> trade-off, not free win.

C-RANK.finding: Labeled a single-variable contrast in the package but ARM-08 and ARM-09 differ in BOTH ranking and representation. Observed effect is exactly 0, and ARM-08/ARM-09 metrics are identical, so H-RANKING=NOT_SUPPORTED. The confound did NOT create a false positive, but the null is not cleanly attributable to ranking alone (it is an under-identified null).

C-RETRIEVAL.note: Largest recall effect; primary cause of recall.

C-SAFE-REFUSAL.note: Strongest, cleanest contrast; isolates the evidentiary-sufficiency heuristic from selection.
C-SAFE-REFUSAL.pair: ARM-01 legacy vs fixed policy (within-arm, selections held constant)

contributing_findings.k: recall + but precision collapses 0.41->0.06 and distractor rate ->0.94; contributing, not a fix
contributing_findings.negative_reservation: retention +0.107 but authority_inversion 327 + recall collapse; contributing with safety trade-off

generalization_limits: All effects bounded to the 280-doc synthetic corpus with LOCAL_PROVIDER_NEUTRAL semantic simulation; the semantic effect is NOT evidence about real embeddings.
method: For each declared contrast, verify the manipulated variable, held-constant variables, confounders, control, contrast size, stability; classify identifiability.

not_supported.ranking: C-RANK effect 0; but contrast confounds ranking+representation -> null is under-identified

primary_findings.safe_refusal_heuristic: SUPPORTED_PRIMARY_CAUSE of unsupported conclusions (C-SAFE-REFUSAL -0.75, clean within-arm).
